definitions.explanation: A newspaper edition published and delivered in the afternoon or evening, as opposed to the morning edition.

examples.japanese: {夕刊|ゆうかん}がまだ{届|とど}いていない。
examples.english: The evening paper hasn't arrived yet.

examples.japanese: うちは{朝刊|ちょうかん}だけで{夕刊|ゆうかん}は{取|と}っていない。
examples.english: We only get the morning paper and don't subscribe to the evening edition.

notes:
USAGE:
Many Japanese newspapers offer both {朝刊|ちょうかん} (morning edition) and {夕刊|ゆうかん} (evening edition) as a set subscription. The evening edition is typically thinner and covers afternoon developments.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {夕刊|ゆうかん}を{読|よ}む (to read the evening paper)
- {夕刊|ゆうかん}を{取|と}る (to subscribe to the evening edition)
- {朝|あさ}{夕刊|ゆうかん}セット (morning and evening edition set)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {朝刊|ちょうかん}: morning newspaper — the main daily edition, typically larger than the evening edition
